title: E0-T1: Define personas - user (Jordan) and buyer (IC/CFO)
description: Composite persona card across 3 archetypes: infra strategy analyst, investment analyst, head of DC development. Document role, goals, frustrations, tools used today, decision criteria. Buyer persona: IC/CFO - what they read, what makes them approve. Output: artifacts/personas.json (structured array of persona objects with fields: id, name, role, archetype, goals[], frustrations[], tools_used[], decision_criteria[], quote) + artifacts/personas.md (narrative, pitch-ready).

title: E0-T2: Customer journey map - before (current pain)
description: AS-IS journey: how Jordan researches EU DC sites today. From mandate to board presentation. Mark pain points: manual data gathering, no unified EU view, carbon data scattered, no supply mix analysis, Excel-based NPV rebuilt each deal. Quantify time/cost of current process. Output: artifacts/journey-before.json (structured journey object: stages[], each with steps[], pain_points[], time_cost, tools_used, emotional_state) + artifacts/journey-before.md (narrative map, pitch-ready).

title: E0-T3: Customer journey map - after (with tool)
description: TO-BE journey with DC Siting Intelligence Tool. Same mandate, same outcome, radically shorter path. Quantify delta: time saved, confidence gained, IC presentation quality. This is the core pitch narrative - the before/after delta IS the value prop. Output: artifacts/journey-after.md

title: E0-T4: Jobs-to-be-done framework
description: 3-5 JTBD statements for user (Jordan) and buyer (IC/CFO). Format: When [situation] I want to [motivation] so I can [outcome]. Cover functional (find optimal site fast), emotional (confidence in IC presentation), social (be seen as rigorous). Used to validate scoring dimensions. Output: artifacts/jtbd.json (structured array: id, persona, situation, motivation, outcome, job_type[functional/emotional/social], validates_dimension[]) + artifacts/jtbd.md (narrative, pitch-ready).

title: E0-T5: Market viability - TAM/SAM/SOM and pricing model
description: Estimate market: EU DC investments/year, deal sizes, advisory fees. TAM/SAM/SOM numbers for pitch deck. Define pricing model (per-query SaaS, subscription, enterprise). Competitive landscape: who does this today (Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE DC advisory, Green Mountain, custom Excel), what is missing, our differentiation. Output: artifacts/market-viability.json (structured: tam_eur, sam_eur, som_eur, pricing_model{}, competitors[{name, what_they_do, gap}]) + artifacts/market-viability.md (narrative, pitch-ready).

title: E0-T6: Pitch narrative and value proposition statement
description: 1-sentence value prop, 3-slide story arc (problem/solution/evidence), key metrics for judges. Synthesizes E0-T1 through E0-T5. Output: artifacts/pitch-narrative.md - used directly in deck.

title: E1-T1: Python project init - src layout, pyproject.toml, uv env
description: Initialize with uv. Layout: src/api, src/core/scoring, src/core/npv, src/core/ml, src/core/signal, src/core/supply, src/data, src/models, src/services, src/ui. Dev deps: fastapi, uvicorn, streamlit, pydantic, pandas, geopandas, folium, scipy, scikit-learn, shap, transformers, pytest.

title: E1-T2: FastAPI skeleton - health endpoint, CORS, error handling
description: FastAPI app with /health, CORS middleware, global exception handler returning structured Pydantic errors. Ready to mount domain routers.

title: E1-T3: Streamlit skeleton - calls FastAPI, placeholder map
description: Streamlit app that calls /health on load. Placeholder choropleth area. Sidebar placeholder for capacity MW + footprint m2 inputs + filter panel.

title: E1-T4: Pydantic domain models - SiteQuery, SiteScore, NPVResult, MLPrediction, SiteResult
description: SiteQuery: capacity_mw, building_footprint_m2, carbon_ceiling_gco2, weights dict. SiteScore: 5 dimension scores + composite. NPVResult: npv_eur, sensitivity_range, capex, annual_opex, annual_revenue. MLPrediction: ml_class, confidence, feature_importances. SiteResult: all of the above + signal_strength + supply_mix + narrative.

title: E2-T1: Ember - EU carbon intensity CSV, zone averages, cache parquet
description: Fetch Ember EU country carbon intensity time series. Compute 12-month trailing average per country. Pro-rate to NUTS2. Cache as parquet. Output: Dict[nuts2_code, gco2_per_kwh].

title: E2-T2: PyPSA-Eur probe - pre-solved network, nodal prices + headroom
description: RISK HIGH. Download pre-solved PyPSA-Eur network from Zenodo. Extract nodal marginal prices, generation headroom, curtailment rates per zone. Map to NUTS2. Time-box 2h. If blocked activate GridSFM probe.

title: E2-T3: GridSFM-Open probe - EU congestion and headroom inference
description: RISK HIGH. Load microsoft/GridSFM-Open from HuggingFace (~15M params). Construct EU grid topology input from OSM + ENTSO-E data in PowerModels.jl-compatible format. Run inference: branch flows, congestion, headroom per zone. Map to NUTS2. Time-box 2h. If EU topology construction fails, use as pitch credibility only. Activate only if PyPSA fails or runs in parallel.

title: E2-T4: [FALLBACK] ENTSO-E/SMARD wholesale prices by country
description: Fallback if both PyPSA and GridSFM fail. Fetch ENTSO-E transparency platform or SMARD wholesale prices by country. Map country to NUTS2. Cache parquet. Activate only after both primary sources exhaust time-box.

title: E2-T5: OSM - EU substations Overpass query, density per NUTS2
description: Overpass API query for EU HV substations. Spatial join to NUTS2 polygons. Compute count and density per 1000km2 per zone. Cache result.

title: E2-T6: NUTS2 geoboundaries - Eurostat shapefile, merge all sources
description: Download NUTS2 2021 shapefile from Eurostat. Merge Ember carbon + PyPSA/GridSFM prices/headroom + OSM substation density + land cost into unified GeoDataFrame. Cache as GeoParquet. Master dataset for all scoring.

title: E2-T7: DC economics constants - PUE, power draw formula, LCOE skeleton
description: Config-driven: PUE=1.4, annual_power_mwh = IT_load_MW * PUE * 8760. LCOE skeleton function signatures. NPV constants: construction_cost_eur_per_mw by region, discount_rate=0.08, horizon=20yr, utilization=0.85, rack_rate defaults.

title: E2-T8: Land cost data - EU land prices by NUTS2, availability proxy
description: Source EU land price estimates by NUTS2: Eurostat LUCAS, ESPON, or proxy from commercial property indices. Compute EUR/m2 per zone. Availability proxy: industrial zoning density from OSM land-use layer. Cache parquet. Risk: data sparse at NUTS2 level, may need country-level + urban/rural split.

title: E3-T1: Scoring schema - 5 dimensions, default weights, normalization config
description: Config-driven schema. Dimensions: cost, carbon, congestion, connectivity, land. Default weights: cost=0.30, carbon=0.25, congestion=0.20, connectivity=0.15, land=0.10. All scores [0,1] higher=better. YAML config.

title: E3-T2: Cost score - wholesale EUR/MWh to [0,1] inverted
description: Normalize wholesale price per NUTS2: cheapest=1.0, most expensive=0.0. Linear interpolation. Missing data: use country average.

title: E3-T3: Carbon score - hard filter on ceiling, score remainder
description: Hard filter: exclude zones above user carbon ceiling. For passing zones normalize inverted: cleanest=1.0. Zones failing filter: score=0, excluded from ranking.

title: E3-T4: Congestion score - headroom/curtailment proxy inverted
description: Use PyPSA or GridSFM headroom + curtailment. Congestion proxy = curtailment_rate / headroom. Invert: low congestion = high score. Handle fallback source.

title: E3-T5: Connectivity score - substation density + fiber proxy
description: OSM substation density -> normalize [0,1]. Fiber proxy: OSM road/telecom density. Combine: 0.7*substation + 0.3*fiber.

title: E3-T6: Land score - EUR/m2 inverted, hard filter on footprint
description: Normalize land EUR/m2 inverted: cheapest=1.0. Hard filter: exclude zones where industrial plot availability cannot fit required building_footprint_m2.

title: E3-T7: Composite ranker - weighted sum, hard filters, top-N with breakdown
description: Composite = sum(dimension_score * weight). Apply all hard filters (carbon + land footprint). Sort descending. Return top-N NUTS2 zones with full per-dimension breakdown. Pure function, no I/O.

title: E3b-T1: NPV constants - construction cost by region, discount rate, horizon, utilization
description: Config: construction_cost_eur_per_mw by EU region (N/S/E/W), discount_rate=0.08, horizon=20yr, default_utilization=0.85, rack_rate_eur_per_mw_yr defaults from EU DC market benchmarks (~100k-150k EUR/MW/yr). PUE=1.4.

title: E3b-T2: DCF engine - compute NPV per NUTS2 zone
description: capex = construction_cost_per_mw * capacity_mw + land_eur_m2 * footprint_m2. annual_opex = blended_energy_cost * capacity_mw * PUE * 8760 + land_lease. annual_revenue = capacity_mw * utilization * rack_rate. npv = sum((revenue-opex)/(1+r)^t, t=1..horizon) - capex. Pure function per zone.

title: E3b-T3: NPV sensitivity - energy cost +/-20%, land cost +/-20% -> NPV range
description: Run DCF with perturbed inputs. Output: npv_base, npv_low, npv_high. Used in site drill-down for IC presentation. Shows robustness of recommendation.

title: E3b-T4: NPV ranker - normalize NPV across zones to [0,1] score
description: Normalize NPV values across all passing NUTS2 zones: highest NPV=1.0. Used as Signal B input to confluence logic.

title: E3c-T1: Synthetic training data - gridfm-datakit + NUTS2 feature augmentation
description: Use gridfm-datakit PF/OPF perturbation pipeline to generate realistic power flow scenarios. Augment with NUTS2 features (energy cost, carbon, land cost, connectivity). Label = scoring rule output + NPV model output + noise. Target: 10k+ labeled samples. Output: training DataFrame.

title: E3c-T2: RF classifier - train, predict good/neutral/bad + SHAP explainability
description: scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier on synthetic data. 3-class output: good/neutral/bad. Confidence = max class probability. MANDATORY: compute SHAP values per prediction. Feature importances logged. No black-box output - every prediction must cite top contributing features.

title: E3c-T3: NPV regression - predict NPV per zone independently
description: RandomForestRegressor predicting NPV. Independent from Signal B DCF - provides ML-based second estimate. Include feature importances. Used to detect divergence between model-based and data-driven NPV estimates.

title: E3c-T4: Signal confluence - combine A+B+C into STRONG/CAUTION/AGAINST + reasoning
description: Inputs: rule_score (A), npv_score (B), ml_class + confidence (C). Logic: all agree positive -> STRONG. Majority positive, one dissents -> CAUTION + cite dissenting signal + feature. Majority negative -> AGAINST. Output: signal_strength enum + human-readable reasoning string citing specific diverging features.

title: E4-T1: LCOE model - blended EUR/MWh for grid/PPA/on-site mix
description: blended = (grid_pct * spot) + (ppa_pct * ppa_rate) + (onsite_pct * onsite_lcoe). Annual cost = blended * capacity_mw * PUE * 8760. Config-driven LCOE defaults per source. Pure function.

title: E4-T2: PPA opportunity flag - curtailment -> discount, flag zones
description: ppa_discount = curtailment_rate * 0.35. Flag zones where discount > 10% as PPA opportunity. Output flag in SiteResult.

title: E4-T3: Supply mix optimizer - optimal grid/PPA/onsite % at user capacity MW
description: Given zone data + user capacity_mw, find grid/PPA/onsite percentages minimizing blended LCOE while meeting carbon target. Output: mix percentages, estimated annual energy cost, carbon outcome.

title: E5-T1: NUTS2 choropleth - composite score fill color, signal_strength badge in tooltip
description: Folium choropleth. Color by composite score (green=high, red=low). Tooltip: zone name, country, composite score, signal_strength badge (STRONG/CAUTION/AGAINST). Renders via st.components.html.

title: E5-T2: Layer toggle - cost/carbon/congestion/connectivity/land/NPV/composite
description: Selectbox to switch map color layer. Each re-colors by that dimension. Instant re-render from cached data.

title: E5-T3: Filter panel - capacity MW + footprint m2 (primary inputs) + carbon ceiling + weights
description: Sidebar: capacity_mw (slider 1-500), building_footprint_m2 (input), carbon_ceiling gCO2/kWh (slider), dimension weight sliders. On change: call /score API, re-render. Debounce 500ms.

title: E5-T4: Site drill-down - signal badge, scores, NPV + sensitivity, supply mix, LCOE
description: Click NUTS2 zone: right panel shows signal badge (STRONG/CAUTION/AGAINST) with reasoning, 5-dimension score table, NPV estimate + low/high sensitivity range, supply mix bar chart (grid/PPA/onsite %), LCOE EUR/MWh + annual EUR cost, plain-language blurb.

title: E5-T5: Narrative generator - Claude haiku, CFO-legible explanation with signal reasoning
description: Claude API (haiku) call with zone scores + NPV + supply mix + signal_strength + reasoning. Prompt: 3-sentence CFO-legible explanation citing signal reasoning and NPV range. Cache per zone+query. Explainable: narrative must reference actual data values.

title: E6-T1: Unit tests - scoring engine, NPV model, ML predictions, confluence logic
description: pytest coverage: all 5 scoring functions, DCF engine, RF predictions + SHAP output, confluence logic (all 4 signal combinations). Assert normalization direction, hard filter exclusion, NPV sign correctness, confluence output enum values.

title: E6-T2: E2E integration test - 3 canned queries, >=3 results, correct ranking, <30s
description: 3 queries: cost-first 100MW/5000m2, carbon-first 50MW/2000m2, balanced 200MW/8000m2. Assert: >=3 results, correct ranking direction per priority, signal_strength present, NPV estimate non-zero, response <30s.

title: E6-T3: Demo scenarios - cost-first (Poland/Balkans), carbon-first (Nordics), balanced (Iberia)
description: 3 hardcoded demo scenarios. Each includes: pre-computed SiteResult with STRONG signal, NPV range, supply mix breakdown, narrative. Fallback if dynamic scoring is slow during demo.

title: E6-T4: README - architecture, data sources, run instructions, signal system explanation
description: ASCII architecture diagram. Data source table with GridFM/GridSFM/PyPSA/Ember/OSM. Setup/run instructions. Explanation of triple-signal system (A+B+C -> STRONG/CAUTION/AGAINST). Known PoC limitations.

title: E0-T7: Stakeholder map - influence/interest grid
description: Map 6-8 stakeholders: IC Partner, CFO/CIO, Head of DC Development (Jordan's manager), ESG Officer, Board/LP, Infrastructure PM. For each: role, what they need from DC siting decision, influence (1-5), interest (1-5), approval trigger, block trigger. Output: artifacts/stakeholder-map.json (structured array of stakeholder objects) + artifacts/stakeholder-map.md (pitch-readable). Used to validate pitch narrative framing in TASK-006.
